The company produces fully cooked, frozen food items using all-natural ingredients and no preservatives. Its product line includes individually portioned servings (12 oz, packed 24 or 32 per case) and party-sized trays (6 lb, packed 2 or 6 per case) that only require reheating, offering a quick and convenient alternative for foodservice operators. Production takes place in a USDA- and FDA-inspected facility where items are cooked, portioned, frozen, and packaged.

Athena Foods primarily supplies restaurants in the Metro-Detroit area. Its portioned and tray products are designed for foodservice use, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

The business emphasizes its commitment to quality through all-natural ingredients, the absence of preservatives, and the convenience of ready-to-heat formats. The family-owned structure is cited as a foundation for consistent product standards.

name: Atlas Precision Inc
old_description: Since 1979, Atlas Precision Plastics has been committed to providing high-quality, cost-effective, plastic injection molding
about:
Atlas Precision Inc. traces its roots to April 1979, when Johann W. Hofschuster founded Atlas Mold Inc. in Arden, North Carolina, to design and build injection molds. In 1988 the company added a custom molding division, Atlas Precision Plastics, and installed its first molding machines the following year. The two operations were combined under one roof in 2006, and the business has remained under Hofschuster's leadership as president and chief executive.

Today the firm operates as a full-service injection molder with 33 presses ranging from 80 to 360 tons, each equipped with a robot or sprue picker. The production floor runs 24/7 across four crews, supported by an on-site toolroom that designs, builds, and maintains multi-cavity tooling, including core-pull, unscrewing, overmolding, and hot-runner systems. A quality lab and RJG/eDart process monitoring complement the molding operation, while 3D printing provides prototype parts. The company works with engineered resins and wood-composite materials.

Atlas serves the healthcare, automotive, telecommunications, industrial, and electrical markets, producing components for medical devices, electrical connectors, packaging, and single-use consumer products. Long-standing customers include Johnson & Johnson (Personal Care and Vistakon divisions), S.C. Johnson, Bic Corporation, Robert Bosch Automotive, Tyco Electronics, and Trex.

The company emphasizes a one-stop-shop model, assigning each customer a dedicated account manager who coordinates design, tooling, molding, and packaging. Hofschuster's team highlights its reputation for building fast-cycling, low-maintenance tooling and holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, CSA International, and UL certifications.

name: Aurora Power & Design Inc.
old_description: We've been in the solar energy business since 1985. As one of the oldest renewable energy companies in the country, we have the edge on solar power. You can depend on us to keep you updated with the most modern, efficient solar power equipment.
about:
Aurora Power & Design Inc. has operated from Boise, Idaho since 1985, making it one of the longest-standing renewable energy firms in the United States. The company was founded to bring solar power solutions to the Intermountain West and has remained a local presence for nearly four decades.

The firm supplies and installs complete solar energy systems for both residential and commercial customers. Its offerings span solar panel sales, battery storage banks, hydropower solutions, and generator hookups. Technicians take a holistic approach to system design, selecting equipment matched to a site’s size and layout and positioning arrays for maximum sun exposure. The company does not disclose its facility size, headcount, or annual project volume.

Aurora serves homeowners and businesses throughout the Boise area seeking to reduce grid dependence or lower energy costs. Typical projects include rooftop and ground-mount photovoltaic arrays for houses, offices, and agricultural operations, as well as off-grid power packages that combine solar, hydro, and backup generation. The company also works with customers interested in hydropower and generator integration.

Aurora emphasizes its longevity as a differentiator, stating that its 1985 founding gives it an edge in sourcing modern, efficient solar equipment. The firm’s stated goal is to help clients “get off the grid” and achieve energy independence through systems that often pay for themselves within a few years.

name: Auto Recyclers
old_description: — not just locally, but nationwide. We ship parts across the country every day and leverage long-standing relationships throughout the automotive recycling industry to source quality parts at fair prices. Those savings are passed directly on to our customers.
about:
Auto Recyclers operates from a 30-acre site on the I-80 service road in Rock Springs, Wyoming. The business was founded in 1980 and has been owned and operated by the Liggett family since its inception. What began as a local salvage yard has grown into a multi-acre operation with a national shipping footprint.

The company maintains an inventory of over 100,000 parts across roughly 2,800 vehicles, supplying used and new auto components to customers across the country. In addition to parts sales, Auto Recyclers runs an in-house transmission and powertrain rebuild facility that specializes in rear-wheel-drive and truck applications, covering classic units such as the TH400, TH350, C4, C6, and modern automatics including the 4L60E, 4L80E, 68RFE, and 6L80E. The shop also rebuilds manual transmissions and transfer cases. Towing and recovery services are offered with a fleet that includes two wreckers, three flatbed tow trucks, tracked snow cats, and light UTV recovery vehicles.

Customers range from independent repair shops and ranchers in the Rock Springs area to collectors and performance builders nationwide. The company’s network of more than 4,000 partner salvage yards allows it to source parts beyond its own stock, and it also procures new old-stock and aftermarket components through dealer relationships.

The Liggett family emphasizes a reputation built on honest pricing, a proper-fit guarantee, and formal warranty terms on every part sold. Their approach is framed by 45 years of consistent service rather than marketing slogans, and they highlight the combined 50-plus years of hands-on automotive experience among their staff as a practical advantage when customers need help identifying the right component.

AutoTecknic states its aim is to increase aerodynamic performance, vehicle stability, and aesthetic appeal through cutting-edge design and skilled craftsmanship. It backs products with a one-year warranty against defects in materials and workmanship under its ISO 9001 quality certification.
